\section[la fiamma]{la fiamma — a flame}

\label{lesson:IT-C256-fiamma}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Italian for a courtyard, then the Italian for a cellar.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: la fiamma}
\textbf{la fiamma} — \textquotedblleft{}a flame\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{fiamma} $\leftarrow$ Latin \emph{flamma}, \textquotedblleft{}a flame\textquotedblright{} — inherited. EtymDB 2.1 has no row for \emph{fiamma}; it derives Spanish \emph{llama} and Old French \emph{flamme} from \emph{flamma}.
\end{cousinweb}
